notes: Caller for the money-rounding macros defined in PyoristysMakrot.sas (PyoristysSentinTarkkuuteen, PyoristysEuronTarkkuuteen, Pyoristys10e, Pyoristys100e). Macro definitions reproduced verbatim (DES strings transliterated to ASCII); &euro set to 1. A DATA step invokes the function-style macros on a small set of example amounts, then PROC PRINT shows each rounding level. Macro logic unchanged.
